name: 02881 · Kingston, RI
findings: ZIP 02881 (Kingston) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (59% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02881 (Kingston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
